AUTHOR: M. Liu; W. Zhang; C. Wei; Z. Bao; J. Hu; J. Zhou
TITLE: PLGAT: Underwater Plectropomus leopardus Recognition Using Global Attention Mechanism and Transfer Learning
REGION: Hainan Yazhou Bay Seed Laboratory, China (PLRD); Limfjorden, Denmark (Brackish)
SPECIES: Plectropomus leopardus (30 individuals as classes, PLRD); Brackish classes (fish, small fish, crab, shrimp, jellyfish, starfish)
DATA: PLRD (own, 129 videos of 30 captive individuals); Brackish dataset
V_EV: Sec. IV-A1: 'the dataset contains small particles in the water, which are considered noise'; 'varying lighting conditions and environmental complexities'
D2: 80/10/10 (4846/605/607 images) for PLRD; Brackish split not described
D_EV: Sec. IV-A1: 'resulting in 6,058 annotated frames. The annotated dataset was subsequently partitioned into training, validation, and test sets ... 80%, 10%, and 10%'
R_EV: Table 3/Sec. IV-B: 'PLGAT model demonstrates strong performance on the PLRD and Brackish datasets' (each evaluated within its own dataset)
E_EV: Sec. IV-A3: 'We use the Precision, Recall, AP, mean average precision (mAP), and Frames per second (FPS) metrics'
ARCH: YOLOv8n + Global Attention Mechanism; transfer COCO -> Brackish -> PLRD
METR: Precision, recall, mAP, FPS, per-class accuracy
NOTE: Eligibility borderline: own PLRD is breeding-laboratory footage (aquaculture/lab); inclusion rests on reported own mAP (~97%) on Brackish (listed field dataset). Brackish results are overall mAP only; tables are images in the text file, so fish-class results could not be verified - verifier should check Table 3. D coded on PLRD (headline); Brackish split not stated. IOU threshold 0.7 is a training/NMS setting, not a confidence threshold. FPS=Y refers to frame extraction every 500 ms. NIMG = PLRD only (Brackish 14,518).
